title: Delivery.
bodyHtml:
§514B-88  Delivery.  In this part, delivery shall be made by:

     (1)  Personal delivery;

     (2)  Registered or certified mail with adequate postage to the recipient's address; provided that delivery shall be considered made three days after deposit in the mail or on any earlier date upon which the return receipt is signed;

     (3)  Facsimile transmission, if the recipient has provided a fax number to the sender; provided that delivery shall be considered made upon the sender's receipt of automatic confirmation of transmission;

     (4)  Electronic mail; or

     (5)  Any other way prescribed by the commission. [L 2005, c 93, pt of §4; am L 2024, c 44, §1]
